schema_note: AuditLab PROSE-1 (MEDIUM, 2026-08-04): the blog guides publish regulatory facts that sit outside every dataset's staleness machinery -- 'when Connecticut changes its carryover rule, nothing on this site will notice.' This registry is that missing tripwire: one row per guide, last_reviewed = the most recent date a human (or a documented audit) actually re-checked the guide's factual claims against their sources. Rendered into each guide's own disclosure block at build time, and checked by scripts/guide_review_staleness_check.py (surfaced via preship_gate.py's advisory section, 90-day threshold). Dates are honest records of real reviews, never bumped without one -- the 2026-08-04 entries are AuditLab's own documented cross-check of every then-existing guide against the verified datasets (auditlab_20260804_PROSE1_uncited_guides.md, 'No factual contradiction found'); later dates are each guide's own authorship date, when its facts were drawn directly from the verified datasets.
